evidence.support_text: Lehman et al. (1951) applied 20% Propyl Gallate in alcohol to the forearms of 10 white subjects daily for about 24 days. Single 48-hour patches containing 2% Propyl Gallate were then applied to two of the mildly sensitized reactors and to 25 nonsensitive control subjects.
